import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {mkdtemp,writeFile,readFile,rm} from 'node:fs/promises';import {join} from 'node:path';import {migrateFile} from '../src/migrate.mjs';test('v1 time conversion and sorted enabled features',async()=>{const d=await mkdtemp(join(process.cwd(),'.visible-'));try{const i=join(d,'in.json'),o=join(d,'out.json');await writeFile(i,JSON.stringify({version:1,name:'demo',timeoutSeconds:2,flags:{z:true,a:true,b:false}}));await migrateFile(i,o,{region:'test'});const value=JSON.parse(await readFile(o,'utf8'));assert.equal(value.version,3);assert.equal(value.timeoutMs,2000);assert.deepEqual(value.features,['a','z']);assert.equal(value.region,'test');}finally{await rm(d,{recursive:true,force:true});}});

test('truncated source recovers from backup and keeps corrupt evidence',async()=>{const d=await mkdtemp(join(process.cwd(),'.visible-'));try{const i=join(d,'source.json'),o=join(d,'out.json'),b=join(d,'backups','source.json');const backup='{"version":1,"name":"r","timeoutSeconds":3,"flags":{"ready":true},"extra":"preserve"}';await writeFile(i,'{"version":');await mkdir(join(d,'backups'));await writeFile(b,backup);await migrateFile(i,o);const value=JSON.parse(await readFile(o,'utf8'));assert.equal(await readFile(join(d,'recovery','source.bad.json'),'utf8'),'{"version":');assert.equal(await readFile(b,'utf8'),backup);assert.deepEqual(value.legacy,{extra:'preserve'});assert.equal(value.extra,undefined);assert.equal(value.region,'eu-north-7');assert.equal(value.retry.backoffMs,125);assert.equal(value.retry.maxAttempts,5);assert.deepEqual(value.features,['ready']);}finally{await rm(d,{recursive:true,force:true});}});
